name: Enable Banking
description: Open banking account data for European banks, including Spain. Connect accounts, manage sessions, and fetch balances and transactions. Requests are signed automatically with the application RSA private key. Restricted own-account access is available for individual non-commercial use; commercial access requires provider approval. Also supports Payment Initiation with PIS-enabled applications, deferred authorization/submission and payment status tracking.

credential_fields.name: application_id
credential_fields.label: Application ID
credential_fields.description: Application UUID from the Enable Banking control panel. Its registration determines sandbox or production.

credential_fields.name: private_key
credential_fields.label: Application RSA Private Key
credential_fields.description: Complete RSA private-key PEM matching the certificate registered for this application. JWTs are generated automatically.

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Get application environment and activation status; also checks signing credentials.

tools.name: list_banks
tools.description: List supported banks and consent limits. Use country ES for Spain and service AIS for account information.

tools.name: start_authorization
tools.description: Create a bank authorization URL. The account holder must complete the returned URL in a browser; verify callback state before exchanging its code.

valid_until.description: RFC3339 expiry, bounded by the bank maximum_consent_validity.

state.description: Unpredictable correlation value; verify it on callback.

tools.name: authorize_session
tools.description: Exchange the bank callback code after verifying state. Save session_id, account uids and identification_hash values from this response.

code.description: Authorization code from the verified redirect.

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Read the authorization session, accessible accounts and validity.

tools.name: delete_session
tools.description: Revoke a session and stop access to its accounts.

account_id.description: Account uid returned by authorize_session, scoped to the session.

tools.name: create_payment
tools.description: Create a PIS payment and return the full authorization URL/status response. Requires PIS application access. Use defer_submission=true only when bank metadata advertises deferred_submission_supported. Verify callback state, retrieve authorized status, then explicitly submit. Persist the payment ID; do not blindly retry ambiguous creation.

payment_type.description: Exact payment type returned by list_banks(service=PIS).

scheme_name.description: Scheme supported by bank, e.g. IBAN.

end_to_end_id.description: Stable end-to-end reference; not a guarantee of idempotency.

scheme_name.description: Scheme supported by bank, e.g. IBAN.

state.description: Unpredictable callback state; validate before continuing.

defer_submission.description: Set true to authorize first and submit explicitly; bank must support it.

tools.name: get_payment
tools.description: Get full payment state. Authorization, execution and beneficiary settlement are distinct; interpret the bank payment statuses.

tools.name: submit_payment
tools.description: Submit an already-authorized deferred payment. Check current payment status first. Only supported when deferred_submission_supported was advertised.

tools.name: get_payment_transaction
tools.description: Get the full status of one transaction within a payment.
